Rebound Quirk.name: Rebound Quirk
Rebound Quirk.description:
🏀 Your body stretches and changes its weight: feather-light bounds, heavy landings.

🧬 A Fusion Quirk of Gravity and Elasticity: each side at about half a single Quirk's reach and force, plus moves only the fusion can do.
🌱 At the start you lighten a person you touch and bounce punches off your torso.
📈 With training: wall-to-wall bounces that land heavy, a stretched net that catches a falling person and sets them down softly, a slingshot launch, blows rebounded at their source, and foes dragged down.
⚠️ Sharp edges and heat hurt your stretched body.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Bodily Toll, as rapid weight swings cause nausea.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: none close.

📈 Grants: Speed +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Mobility +10, Acrobatics +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Buoyant Tap, Snapback Belly
Rebound Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: the body stretches, rebounds and shifts own or touched weight. New adult user: limbs stretch about 5 m; self or up to half a car's weight turns feather-light or doubles; punches bounce off the torso; more needs techniques. Limits: sharp edges and bullets pierce the stretched body; heat burns stretched skin; touch shifts need bare skin, end if knocked out. Quirk Strain: light: buoyant tap, belly rebound; moderate: weighted grab, spring tether, wall-bounce drop, catching net; heavy: bracing a load; severe: signature slingshot, spanning a street, awakened uses. Fusion: gravity + elasticity, each about half a single-nature user's range and force: no multi-ton floats, street crush fields or elastic air panes; only it does wall-bounce drops, weightless nets, slingshots, blows rebounded to source. Type: Emitter (also fits Transformation). Law: heavy-weight slams are assault; unlicensed launches risk traffic crashes. Look: springy step.
